title: KV cache drift detection, sequence-cluster alerts, and fallback pinning playbook
creator: Avery Chen
description:
Problem: During model onboarding we observe that sequence-distribution shifts (e.g., sudden increase in tail-long sequences or different tokenization patterns) can lead to degraded KV cache hit-rate and increased p99 latency. We need an operational playbook that: (1) detects distribution drift for model+version and sequence clusters, (2) maps drift signals to automatic or operator-driven fallback/version pinning policies, and (3) publishes per-model performance profile updates to the catalog with a safe rollout path.

Goals:
- Early detection of KV cache performance regressions tied to sequence-distribution shifts.
- Clear, auditable fallback path: short-circuit to previously pinned model variant or to a cheaper/compat variant when degradation crosses thresholds.
- Automated profile-publish workflow that includes canary, golden trace validation, and rollback triggers.

Scope and non-goals:
- Scope: telemetry schema updates, detection rules, alerting playbook, orchestration for fallback pinning, and documentation for SRE/PM/EMs. Includes integration with Console dashboards and runtime routing.
- Non-goal: model training or changes to model weights. Not implementing new kernel-level cache eviction heuristics in this ticket (separate follow-up).
acceptance_criteria: Telemetry schema updated: sequence-cluster id emitted for >=90% of requests for onboarded models in staging

Drift detector runs continuously on staging and sends alerts to #kvcache-alerts with actionable context (model, version, cluster, recent kv-hit-rate, p50/p95/p99 latency) within 5 minutes of crossing thresholds

Fallback automation implemented: when a model-version's kv-hit-rate drops below 60% and p99 latency increases by >30% vs. baseline for 10m, system triggers a canary fallback to pinned variant and records event in audit log
Profile publish workflow: operator can promote a new performance profile after running golden-trace validation; promotion creates a canary rollout that is reversible via the Console within 15 minutes
Documentation and runbook published in Confluence with playbook steps, escalation path, and example queries for the observability dashboard
